scope: /erpv2/company/feo/requests/transfers — create, preview, history, revert confirmation and persisted address
supersedes: The create preview count, history layout, confirmation warning and address-mode persistence clauses of feo-transfer-popups-20261024

approved.create_form: Use the existing .field-textarea role for the 96px requests box with the system line height and existing .field-label/.radio-item roles. The destination legend has 6px bottom spacing before the radios. No new one-page field or font role.
approved.create_preview: Automatic preview has no Заявок: N. caption above the four-column bordered table. The future-result column is Станет. Existing shared table, border, cell padding and scroll rules remain.
approved.history: Read-only desktop layout has two groups: left .page-eyebrow ЗАЯВКИ and every request ID, right .page-eyebrow ПЕРЕМЕЩЕНЫ ПО АДРЕСУ. Request mode shows bold destination ID followed by its full stored address. Address mode shows the entered full address, Yandex coordinates and static precision badge/description. No old mode, form-field or found-address labels. The completed-result column is Стало. Address-to-coordinate gap is 4px; precision row follows 8px after coordinates. Mobile groups stack using existing .registry-ui-modal-grid--reading.
approved.revert_confirmation: One sentence lists every affected request ID in shared bold type and says they return to prior addresses and coordinates. Remove the extra sentence about later transfers; server-side conflict protection still applies. Existing red .btn-danger Выполнить возврат and secondary Отменить remain.
approved.address_persistence: For a new address-mode transfer, preserve the exact trimmed text entered by the user as destination address, table Стало, feo_requests.mno_adres_pogruzki, history, after_json and any enabled legacy mirror payload. Yandex supplies longitude, latitude, precision and quality; its normalized address is not the saved destination. Current address input must match the original query in the server-issued, account/company-bound geo token at preview. A changed value requires a fresh geocode. Server preview token and state hash bind the result through commit. Request-mode transfers and existing historical records are not rewritten.
